categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through four main segments: drilling services, oilfield technical services, marine vessel services, and geophysical exploration and engineering survey services. It provides single operation services, bundled services, integrated services, and turnkey contracting services across all stages of oil and gas exploration, development, and production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology-driven strategies with advanced drilling platforms including jack-up rigs and semi-submersible rigs. It develops proprietary technologies such as the 'Xuanji' system for well logging and directional drilling, and invests in digital transformation and smart oilfield services. It also focuses on LNG-powered vessels and green low-carbon technologies in its fleet.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily oil and gas exploration and production companies, including major domestic and international oil companies. The company serves clients in China and overseas markets such as Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Americas, Europe, and Africa, providing services tailored to offshore and onshore oilfields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong domestic presence in China, accounting for about 77.4% of revenue, and expanding international operations covering Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Americas, Europe, and Africa. It operates drilling platforms and vessels globally and has subsidiaries in key regions including Norway, Singapore, and Mexico.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain, providing essential oilfield services such as drilling, technical support, vessel operations, and geophysical surveys that support upstream exploration and production activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology innovation, cost leadership, integration of services, internationalization, and regional development. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop proprietary technologies, digital oilfield platforms, and green energy solutions, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and expand overseas markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for drilling, technical services, vessel operations, and geophysical surveys. The company earns income from day rates of drilling rigs, service fees, product sales related to oilfield technologies, and turnkey project contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest integrated oilfield service providers globally and the leading player in the Chinese market. It competes with other international oilfield service companies by leveraging its technological capabilities, integrated service offerings, and extensive fleet of drilling rigs and vessels.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 48.2 billion, a 9.5% increase year-over-year, with net profit of RMB 3.4 billion, up 3.5%. It operates over 60 drilling platforms and 200 vessels, with a workforce of over 15,500 employees. The company shows steady growth and maintains a solid financial position with total assets around RMB 83 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly full lifecycle oilfield services. Its competitive advantages include advanced proprietary technologies, integrated service capabilities, a large and modern fleet of rigs and vessels, and strong risk management. It also focuses on digital transformation and green energy solutions to differentiate itself in the market.
